item.guhs.guh_clothes.lore: Right-click your tame guh to dress them up
item.guhs.mika_mepper.lore: Hits Mikas three times as hard
block.guhs.frying_pan.no_fat: The pan needs Mika's Grease first
block.guhs.frying_pan.full: The pan is full of grease
block.guhs.guh_wheel.no_guh: Pick up your tame guh (sneak + right-click), then right-click the wheel
item.guhs.vahoege_vads_shears.lore: Never breaks. Snip away, nyeg! The sheep thinks it is wahoog.
item.guhs.guh_cave_compass.lore: Points to the center room of the nearest guh cave
item.guhs.challenge_compass.lore: Points to the dungeon hall of the nearest challenging guh cave
item.guhs.picked_up_guh.hint: Right-click a block to put them down, or a guh wheel to go for a run
block.guhs.guh_wheel.occupied: A guh is already running in this wheel
block.guhs.bank_guh.lore: So chonky that endless stuff fits in their tummy
entity.guhs.quest_guh.request: Guh guh... I'm sooo hungry! Bring me %s fried cheese nibbles (in your hand) and you'll get something super chonky. (You have %s now.)
entity.guhs.quest_guh.thanks: Nom nom nom! Thank you! Here, take my buddy the Bank Guh - they can eat anything and are never full!
item.guhs.guh_buikfluitje.lore: Blow it (or press G) to travel to your guhbelly and back
item.guhs.mika_spoorkompas.lore: Points to the nearest Mika Camp
item.guhs.taartkruimels.lore: A trail of crumbs... to the nearest Guh Picnic (in the Overworld too)
item.guhs.verloren_guh_taart.lore: Mother Chonky's cake. Don't eat it!
item.guhs.guh_kristal_verrekijker.lore: Use it: rare guhs within 64 blocks start to glow
item.guhs.guhdex.lore: All the guhs you've seen and tamed
item.guhs.sleeglijder.lore: Part of the broken sled (guh caves)
item.guhs.guh_belletje.lore: Part of the broken sled (guh villages)
item.guhs.sleebouwersboek.lore: Needed (not used up) to make sled rails
item.guhs.guh_slee.lore: Put it on a sled rail. Right-click while riding: the control panel
item.guhs.guh_slee.needs_rail: A sled belongs on a sled rail
item.guhs.sleerail.lore: 4x4 blocks. Click the end of a rail to connect to it
item.guhs.sleerail.slope.lore: Goes up 4; sneak (at the end of a rail) to go down
item.guhs.sleerail.blocked: There's no room for this piece of rail
item.guhs.guh_compass.how: Always points to the nearest one in this dimension; hold it to see how far
item.guhs.heiligdom_kompas.lore: Points to Mother Chonky's Chonky Shrine (Guhmension). Sold by the Chonk Tamer.
item.guhs.sleerail.drop.lore: Up 8 over 4 blocks: a real roller-coaster hill. Sneak (at the end of a rail) to go down
item.guhs.sleerail.spiral.lore: Half a turn, up 4: you come back 3 blocks further on. Sneak for left; look down to descend
item.guhs.sleerail.jump.lore: The sled flies 10 blocks through the air. Click the end: the next piece appears at the landing spot by itself
item.guhs.kermiskompas.lore: Points to the Guh Fair in the Guhmension. Sold by the Chonk Tamer.
entity.guhs.guh_slee.hint: Right-click: the control buttons (start, speed, reverse)
item.guhs.verstopkompas.lore: Points to the Hide-and-Guh House in the Guhmension. Sold by the Chonk Tamer.
painting.guhs.guh_stapel.title: The Guh Stack
painting.guhs.guh_stapel.author: The guhs
item.guhs.reisguh_fluitje.lore: Blow it somewhere in the Guhmension: a Travel Guh settles there, your own travel point
item.guhs.koningskompas.lore: Points to the legendary Guh Castle (Guhmension). It can be very far away!
item.guhs.guhmensie_superkompas.lore: Right-click: choose what you're looking for. It points to the nearest one (in this dimension).
item.guhs.guhmensie_superkompas.choose: Right-click to choose what you're looking for
item.guhs.guhmensie_superkompas.chosen: The Super Compass is now looking for: %s
item.guhs.guh_compass.old: Old compass: replaced by the Guhmension Super Compass
jukebox_song.guhs.ze_hangen: Guh - They Hang On My Chonk
item.guhs.showrozet.lore: Won on the catwalk of the Guh Beauty Theater. Spend it at the Show Guh.
entity.guhs.race_ghost.name: Your record ghost (%s)
item.guhs.mika_mep_hamer.lore: Borrowed from the Whack Guh: it goes back after the game. Left-click the Mikas!
subtitles.guhs.disco.ze_hangen_disco70: Disco music: They Hang On My Chonk
block.guhs.disco_milkshake.slurp: Slurp! ...nyeg, this one's just for looking at. Real shakes are sold by the DJ Guh!
item.guhs.guhgolfclub.lore: Hold right-click near your ball to charge the power bar, look where it needs to go and let go to swing. WAHOOG!
item.guhs.guhgolfclub.loan: Borrowed from the Golf Guh: she wants it back after your round.
item.guhs.smulschaal.lore: Borrowed from the Munch Guh: it goes back after the game
item.guhs.guhvis_hengel.lore: Borrowed from the Fishing Guh for the contest. Afterwards it swims back all by itself!
item.guhs.kaasvis.lore: Full of little holes and smells like cheese nibbles
item.guhs.vadsbaars.lore: The chonkiest fish in the Guhmension. So chonk!
item.guhs.guhpuffer.lore: Puffs up when it gets a fright. WAHOOG!
item.guhs.njegforel.lore: Rare and quick. Says 'nyeg' when you catch it
item.guhs.mika_meerval.lore: Grumpy whiskers. Costs points and tastes like Mika. Yuck!
item.guhs.gouden_guhvis.lore: Legendary! Only the luckiest anglers ever see one
item.guhs.vissen.puffer_eaten: PUFF! You puff up like a guhpuffer!
item.guhs.vissen.golden_collect: A collectible: every fish caught gets the angler's name and its weight
item.guhs.leenhouweel.lore: Only for the Cheese Mine: the Miner Guh takes it back when you leave
item.guhs.kaashouweel.lore: Chops cheese veins twice as fast. Wahoog!
item.guhs.goudkaas.lore: Rare and golden yellow. The Cheese Vault opens for 2 of them
block.guhs.karretjesautomaat.lore: Right-click: a minecart on the rails next to it
item.guhs.bieb_boek.lore: Guh book %s of %s - from the Guh Library
item.guhs.bieb_boek.lore_secret: The secret guh book - don't tell anyone!
item.guhs.boekenbon.lore: Spend it at the Librarian in the Guh Library
item.guhs.gouden_kaasknabbel.lore: Fell from the sky in a Cheese Shower. No wild guh can resist it: instantly tame!
item.guhs.sterrenstof.lore: Left behind by a shooting star. Toss it up and make a wish!
item.guhs.sterrenstof.wish: You make a wish... and suddenly the dark isn't so dark anymore. WAHOOG!
emote.guhs.ukelele.description: 626-guh only: grabs his ukulele and plays a little song. "Aloha, nyeg!"
emote.guhs.dansen.description: Shakes their chonk to the beat.
emote.guhs.slapen.description: Curls up and snores softly. Zzz...
emote.guhs.vahoeg.description: A happy jump with a spin. WAHOOG!
emote.guhs.rollen.description: Rolls onto their back and wiggles their pawsies.
emote.guhs.smakken.description: Munches an imaginary cheese nibble. Crumbs everywhere!
emote.guhs.verlegen.description: Hides their eyes behind their pawsies... and peeks.
emote.guhs.gapen.description: A huge yawn and a long stretch. Good morning, guh!
emote.guhs.zingen.description: Sings a guh song and wiggles along. Gardens nearby grow faster from it!
emote.guhs.knuffelen.description: Gives a big chonky cuddle. Hearts!
emote.guhs.hartjes.description: Blows little hearts your way, paw to snoot. Sweet chonkies together!
emote.guhs.knuffeldansje.description: A happy twirly dance with little hops. Mega sweet and mega chonky!
emote.guhs.bff_knuffel.description: Stands up on their hind pawsies and hugs you as hard as they can. Soulguh bff 5evr <3
emote.guhs.verdrietje.description: Ears down, a tiny sigh... oh nyeg. Luckily a cuddle always helps.
item.guhs.parel.lore: From the giant clams of the Guh Bubble. The Merguh accepts them as money.
item.guhs.duikhelm.lore: Breathe underwater (and see a bit better down there too).
block.guhs.kaaskoraal.lore: Blows air bubbles: underwater you can breathe again right next to it.
item.guhs.oog_van_vadsig.lore: Throw it in the Guhmension: it flies to the nearest Nibble Cellar
item.guhs.knabbelkristal.lore: Full of stolen cheese nibbles. Four on the nibble pedestals call Overlord Mika back
item.guhs.knabbelkroon.lore: Overlord Mika's crown. Yours now. WAHOOG!
item.guhs.knabbelkroon.lore2: Wahoog aura: never really hungry, happy guhs, hard whacks against Mikas
item.guhs.guhvleugels.lore: Little Enderguh wings to float with. Repair with Mika's Grease
block.guhs.motknabbel.lore: A glowing cheese moth nibble, spat out by a frogguh
item.guhs.vadsverdrijvend_drankje.lore: Throw it! Whoever it hits feels unwahoog for a bit
block.guhs.guhnestje.lore: Guhs sleep in it at night, the whole family. Your tame guhs too!
item.guhs.knabbelbessen.lore: Baby guhs adore them: wild baby guhs are easy to tame with them
block.guhs.vadshout_zaailing.lore: Four in a square: a giant guh tree!
item.guhs.aanmaakblokje.lore: Click inside a grill coal frame (Guhmension or Barbecuether): the barbecue fires up! Also works as a lighter.
item.guhs.grillguh_recept.lore: With charcoal, flint and a cheese nibble it makes Fire Starter Cubes. The recipe stays in the grid.
item.guhs.guhdrankje.vahoegheid.lore: Cheese broth with nibbles. You run like a guh chasing a nibble: WAHOOG!
item.guhs.guhdrankje.rookloop.lore: Cheese broth with glowcoal. Through smoke, fire and cheese frying sauce without a single scorch mark.
item.guhs.guhdrankje.sluipknabbel.lore: Cheese broth with swamp cheese or Mika's Grease. Quiet as a nibble in a bag, nyeg.
item.guhs.guhdrankje.guhsprong.lore: Cheese broth with guh slime. Boing! And gently back down.
block.guhs.pluisgras.lore: Soft pink fluff. Every now and then a little puff floats off.
block.guhs.pluizenboom_zaailing.lore: Grows into a fluffy pink tree
block.guhs.guhpaddenstoel.lore: Bone meal on it: a giant guh mushroom!
block.guhs.feestbuffettafel.lore: During a Cozyfest it's full of yummy treats
block.guhs.seizoensbloembak.lore: Blooms along with the seasons. Right-click: what can you do with it now?
block.guhs.knus_oorkonde.lore: For the Snuggle Mayor of Snuggledale
item.guhs.knusfeestlijstje.lore: Right-click: which party chores are still open?
item.guhs.sneeuwguhkopje.lore: Put me on two snow blocks!
item.guhs.sneeuwguhkopje.hoe: Put the snowguh head on top of two snow blocks and you've got a snowman guh!
item.guhs.feesttaart.lore: Three layers of chonky happiness, in a pink box with a bow
item.guhs.feesttaart.lore2: For Mayor Chonkworth and the Great Cozyfest. No eating it on the way, nyeg!
item.guhs.knabbelbroodje.lore: Crunchy bun with nibble crumbs. Makes you speedy!
item.guhs.knabbelbroodje.njam: Nom! Nibble zoom: you run like a hungry guh!
item.guhs.kaaskrakeling.lore: A twisted pretzel of cheese dough with sugar. Quick little hands!
item.guhs.kaaskrakeling.njam: Crunchity-crunch! Your little hands are suddenly speedy.
item.guhs.vadsvlaai.lore: A whole cheese pie. Chonky? Nah: just WAHOOG.
item.guhs.vadsvlaai.njam: Mmm, chonk pie! An extra layer of cuddle padding for when things get rough.
item.guhs.guhcroissant.lore: A crescent of puff pastry with cheese. It gives you sweet little looks.
item.guhs.guhcroissant.njam: Boing! A guhcroissant makes you all bouncy.
item.guhs.knabbelkoekje.lore: A little cookie for in between. Quick to eat, quick to go!
item.guhs.knabbelkoekje.njam: Crumble crumble... and off you go, full speed!
item.guhs.kaasbolletje.lore: A soft roll with melted cheese. Patches you right up.
item.guhs.kaasbolletje.njam: Warm and cheesy... you feel better right away, nyeg.
item.guhs.pluismuffin.lore: So fluffy you gently float away.
item.guhs.pluismuffin.njam: Fluff! You feel light as a little cloud.
item.guhs.theetaartje.lore: With a pink heart and powdered sugar. Brings luck (and a craving for tea).
item.guhs.theetaartje.njam: What a sweet little tart. Today's going to be a lucky day!
item.guhs.knabbeltompouce.lore: Pink icing, yellow cream, two crunchy layers. Strong stuff!
item.guhs.knabbeltompouce.njam: Splat, cream on your snoot! You feel strong as a guh castle.
item.guhs.vadsdonut.lore: A little ring with pink icing and sprinkles. Boing boing!
item.guhs.vadsdonut.njam: Sprinkles! Your legs want to jump!
item.guhs.guhwafel.lore: A round waffle with sugar. Helps you hold your breath underwater for ages.
item.guhs.guhwafel.njam: Waffle bubbles! Now you can nibble underwater for ages.
item.guhs.sterrenkoekje.lore: A little star with pink icing: you can see everything at night with it.
item.guhs.sterrenkoekje.njam: Twinkle twinkle! Your eyes can see in the dark.
block.guhs.guh_wiegje.lore: A cradle with a little guh face. Right-click to rock it: baby guhs nearby grow a little.
block.guhs.speelkleed.lore: A soft play mat with a smiling guh. For crawling on!
block.guhs.feestslingers.lore: Crafted by the baby guhs of the Snuggle Daycare. For the Great Cozyfest!
item.guhs.speenmunt.lore: The coin of the Snuggle Daycare. Spend it at Miss Snuggles (and in the claw machine).
item.guhs.babyflesje.lore: Warm cheese milk for baby guhs. Your own baby guh grows a little from it too. Slurp!
item.guhs.schone_luier.lore: Fresh and soft. Baby guhs get sooo wahoog from it!
item.guhs.knuffeldekentje.lore: A soft little blanket of fluff wool. Tuck a baby guh in with it: zzz...
block.guhs.theetafel.lore: A round table with a flowery tablecloth. Put guh chairs around it for a tea party.
block.guhs.theepotje.lore: Put something yummy in it (cheese nibbles, cheese milk, tea herb or guh flowers): two cups of tea!
item.guhs.feest_theeservies.lore: Mrs. Teaspoon's prettiest tea set, borrowed for the Great Cozyfest. Careful!
item.guhs.knabbelthee.lore: Tea made of cheese nibbles: golden brown, crunchy in taste and a little bit snug.
item.guhs.kaasmelkthee.lore: Creamy and soft. Washes away all nasty effects!
item.guhs.theekruidthee.lore: Green and fresh, from tea herb out of your garden. Perks you right up.
item.guhs.guhbloementhee.lore: Pink tea made of guh flowers. So snug, for a whole minute and a half!
item.guhs.feestkapselset.lore: Clips, bows and glitter spray for the party hairdos. Bring it to Mayor Chonkworth!
item.guhs.kappersschaar.lore: Borrowed from Curly the Barber. Right-click a customer to give them a trim.
item.guhs.kappersschaar.lore2: Shift + right-click your own tame guh: all the hair comes off (nyeg!)
item.guhs.haarverf.lore: Right-click your own tame guh that has a hairstyle: their hair gets this color
item.guhs.kapsel.lore: A lasting hairstyle: right-click your own tame guh (the old hairstyle is then gone)
block.guhs.guh_voerbak.lore: Put nibble feed in it: the farm animals eat from it by themselves
block.guhs.kippennestje.lore: Happy nibble chicks lay their nibble eggs here
item.guhs.pluiswol.lore: Super soft, from a happy guh lamb
item.guhs.knabbelei.lore: An egg from a happy nibble chick, crunchy as a cheese nibble
item.guhs.kaasmelk.lore: Creamy and a little bit cheesy. From a happy guh cow. Moo!
item.guhs.guhborstel.lore: Brush the farm animals: fluffy is happy
item.guhs.knabbelvoer.lore: Yummy for lambs, chicks and cows (and secretly for guhs too)
block.guhs.guh_bloempot.lore: Put seeds in and give it water. Right-click when it's ripe!
block.guhs.guh_moestuinbak.lore: A whole row of little plants in a planter. Tame guhs water it!
item.guhs.guh_gieter.lore: Right-click a garden: water! Empty? Refill it at some water.
item.guhs.knabbelzaadjes.lore: Grows into a little nibble plant full of nibble grain
item.guhs.theekruidzaadjes.lore: Grows into a fragrant bunch of tea herb
item.guhs.guhbloemzaadjes.lore: Grows into a guh flower (with a little face!)
item.guhs.knabbelgraan.lore: Crunchy grain for the baker's nibble dough
item.guhs.theekruid.lore: Smells like mint and cheese nibbles. For the tea house!
item.guhs.guhbloemetje.lore: A pink little flower that looks back at you. Five make a party bouquet
item.guhs.feestboeket.lore: For Mayor Chonkworth's Great Cozyfest. WAHOOG!
block.guhs.guh_telescoop.lore: At night: right-click and connect the stars into a guh constellation
block.guhs.sterrenlantaarn.lore: A little lantern with a star inside. For the Great Cozyfest!
item.guhs.wensster.lore: Right-click and make a wish! (Or pay Professor Twinkle with it)
block.guhs.ballonsteiger.lore: The hot-air balloon waits here. Talk to Captain Cloudy to climb aboard!
block.guhs.mini_luchtballon.lore: A tiny guh balloon with a teeny-tiny burner. Doesn't really float, but almost
item.guhs.ballonmunt.lore: For every balloon flight. Spend it at Captain Cloudy
block.guhs.guh_slaapzak.lore: Sleep without a bed! (Your spawn point stays where it was.) After a whole night: well-rested
item.guhs.guhshampoo.lore: On your tame guh at a guh washtub: step 1 of the bath ritual
item.guhs.guh_fohn.lore: Hold right-click on a rinsed guh: dry, fluffy and shiny!
item.guhs.knuffelbad_badeendje.lore: Put it on the water: it bobs and squeaks when you pet it
item.guhs.guh_fluitje.tooltip: Whistle your latest song: all guhs nearby sing along (and the gardens grow from it).
item.guhs.wereldleven_liedjesboekje.tool: Six guh songs, with the bars of the guh xylophone. Practicing is always allowed!
item.guhs.kaasijsje_mint.tooltip: Fresh mint with cheese flakes. Makes you run a bit faster.
item.guhs.kaasijsje_choco.tooltip: Chocolate cheese: you suddenly feel light as a little puff.
item.guhs.kaasijsje_bloesem.tooltip: Spring only: pink blossom with cheese. Blushies and a warm feeling.
item.guhs.kaasijsje_zonnetje.tooltip: Summer only: lemon cheese with a little sun on top. Floaty and fast!
item.guhs.kaasijsje_appeltaart.tooltip: Fall only: apple pie with cheese and crumbs. Warm inside.
item.guhs.kaasijsje_sneeuw.tooltip: Winter only: snow-white vanilla cheese. Brr... and still yummy.
item.guhs.pieppiepmuisje_item.tooltip: Right-click a block: the mousie hops off. Right-click in the air: onto your shoulder! Squeak.
item.guhs.poepschilly_item.tooltip: A picked-up Poopshelly (name and all). Right-click a block: it waddles off again. Blub!
item.guhs.schilly_item.tooltip: A picked-up Shelly (name and all). Right-click a block: there's Shelly again. Tiny head!
block.guhs.roze_guh_koek.tooltip: Eat it: Puppy Eyes! Place it: a tray with room for six. Empty hand: gobble one up, sneak: take one.
item.guhs.roze_guh_koek_recept.tooltip: Right-click to learn the secret recipe. Then bake it in the Nibble Oven: sweet dough, disc, icing. Nyeg!
item.guhs.guh_clothes.ontgrendel: Hold right-click to unlock: then all your guhs can wear it!
item.guhs.guh_clothes.al_ontgrendeld: Already unlocked! Give it to a friend, nyeg.
item.guhs.sjoelen_schijven.lore: Stand at the head of the shuffleboard, hold right-click (the power bar goes up and down), look where it needs to go and let go. Shuffle away!
item.guhs.sjoelen_schijven.loan: Borrowed from Granny Nyegshuffle: after your turn they go back in her little box.
item.guhs.gestolen_knabbel.lore: Found again in the maze! Bring it to the exit (Mr. Chonkwiggle makes sure it gets back to the guhs).
item.guhs.katapult_pluisballen.lore: Stand at the catapult, look where it needs to go, hold right-click to pull back the band and let go: FLOOP!
item.guhs.katapult_pluisballen.loan: Borrowed from Captain Floopguh: soft as a guh, and they go back after your round.
item.guhs.guh_zak.lore: For the sack race: jump to hop!
item.guhs.knabbelei_lepel.lore: Walk slowly, or it'll fall! Coach Wahoogaroo wants her spoon back.
item.guhs.knabbelspijker.lore: It dangles from your guh belt. Plop it into the cheese milk bottle!
block.guhs.rijpsprietjes.lore: Crackly little sprouts full of frost. Snip them with shears!
block.guhs.guh_ijsbloempje.lore: A see-through ice-blue little flower with a teeny guh face. Light blue dye!
block.guhs.ijspegelguh_kristal.lore: A glowing ice crystal shaped like a guh ear. Is it listening? Nyeg!
block.guhs.guh_molentje.lore: Grinds nibble grain into nibble flour. Faster when it snows, super wahoog in a storm!
item.guhs.knabbelmeel.lore: Freshly ground in a guh windmill. In the nibble oven you bake twice as much with it!
item.guhs.guh_schaatsen.lore: Borrowed from Skate Master Guhglide. Hold them and glide over the ice!
item.guhs.guh_schaatsen.how: On ice you skate super wahoog; off it you just walk, nyeg.
item.guhs.stempelkaart.lore: %s of the 11 stamps. Right-click: the whole card.
item.guhs.warme_chocovet.lore: Thick hot cocoa with whipped cream. Warm inside = extra wahoog for a bit!
item.guhs.snert_kommetje.lore: Pea soup so thick the spoon stands up in it. Then you skate faster all by yourself!
item.guhs.guh_brandslang.lore: Hold right-click to spray. Too-chonky little fires go out by themselves
item.guhs.kaasmelkdrankje.lore: Sniffle herbs and cheese milk, mixed in the mixing cauldron. Good for every runny nose
item.guhs.kaasmelkdrankje.gedronken: Your nose is all clear again. WAHOOG!
item.guhs.snotkruidje.lore: For the mixing cauldron. Don't sniff it, or... achoo!
item.guhs.beroepen_dakpan.lore: Only fits on a roof spot of Bob the Guhbuilder's roof
block.guhs.beroepen_dakplek: Roof Spot (a roof tile still goes here)
block.guhs.beroepen_marshmallowvuur.lore: Snug with marshmallows. Is it blazing up too chonky? Call the fire brigade!
block.guhs.beroepen_mengketel.lore: 3 sniffle herbs and a cheese milk in: blub blub, a cheese milk potion
block.guhs.beroepen_knabbelbuit.lore: With a pink Mika pawprint on it. Whose could that be?
block.guhs.guhhuisje.lore: Room for %s residents: guhs, mousies, Shelly and Poopshelly
block.guhs.guhhuisje_klein.lore: A cozy guh head: the ears are the roof, the eyes the windows, the snoot the door.
block.guhs.guhhuisje_medium.lore: With flower boxes under the eyes. Extra snug!
block.guhs.guhhuisje_groot.lore: With a little chimney and a bow on the ear. Villa Wahoog!
block.guhs.klusjes_guhlampje.lore: A lamp with ears and a sweet little face. Right-click: on or off. Residents of a Guh House turn it on in the evening and off in the morning!
item.guhs.klusjes_schelpje.lore: Fished up by a house guh. Hold it to your ear (right-click) and listen to the Guh Sea.
item.guhs.klusjes_schelpje.oor.0: Shhhh... you hear the Guh Sea. And very softly: nyeg.
item.guhs.klusjes_schelpje.oor.1: Shhhh... somewhere far away a little wave of cheese sauce sloshes.
item.guhs.klusjes_schelpje.oor.2: Shhhh... a little fish whispers: "that guh is a pretty good fisher, you know".
item.guhs.klusjes_schelpje.oor.3: Shhhh... you hear a guh snoring. Oh wait, that's your own guh.
item.guhs.klusjes_schelpje.oor.4: Shhhh... WAHOOG! (the sea is happy you're listening)
item.guhs.klusjes_schelpje.oor.5: Shhhh... the seashell smells like salt and a tiny bit like cheese nibbles.
block.guhs.guh_glijbaantje.lore: A climbing frame with guh ears, a platform on a guh snoot and a shiny slide. Wheee!
block.guhs.guh_glijbaantje.uitleg: Guhs climb up and slide down. Right-click to slide yourself.
block.guhs.guh_wip.lore: A seesaw on a little guh head, with cushions and guh-ear handles.
block.guhs.guh_wip.uitleg: Two guhs seesaw up and down together. Right-click: a little push. Sneak + right-click: seesaw yourself.
block.guhs.guh_schommel.lore: A pink swing with a guh head on the beam and a soft cushion.
block.guhs.guh_schommel.uitleg: A guh swings on it by themselves. Right-click: push, higher! Sneak + right-click: swing yourself.
block.guhs.pluizige_tunnel.lore: Soft pink fur tunnel. Join the pieces together for a twisty tunnel!
block.guhs.pluizige_tunnel.uitleg: Guhs run through it and hide inside. Knock on it (right-click) to find them.
item.guhs.knabbelbal.leeg: Empty: put a cheese nibble in it (right-click)
item.guhs.knabbelbal.uitleg: Put it down: guhs push it around until the nibble rolls out. Left-click to kick!
item.guhs.guhbel.lore: Ding-a-ling! A golden little bell with guh ears.
item.guhs.guhbel.uitleg: Right-click: send your guhs to the Guh Room in your Guhbelly, or call them back to you.
item.guhs.timmerguh_bouwboekje.lore: All three Guh Houses are in it: small, medium and large.
item.guhs.timmerguh_bouwboekje.lore2: Just stays in your crafting table when you build a house. Tap tap, nyeg!
item.guhs.timmerguh_dakpluisje.lore: Borrowed from Carpenter Guh. Only fits on the see-through spots of his ear roof.
block.guhs.baltoguh_beeldje.lore: A bronze Baltoguh on a snowy pedestal. For the Hero of Nomguh. Click: awooo!
block.guhs.baltoguh_beeldje.klik: "...But maybe, just maybe... a Baltoguh can." Awooo-nyeg!
block.guhs.nomguh_routepaal.lore: Red and white, with a glowing guh ear on top: you'll never get lost in the snowstorm.
block.guhs.nomguh_medicijnkist.lore: The medicine for the baby guhs of Nomguh. Take good care of it, nyeg!
block.guhs.sneeuwguhspar_zaailing.lore: A teeny-tiny spruce with a little snow cap. Grows into a real snowguh spruce!
item.guhs.sneeuwslee.lore: Your own sled with four guh sled pups. Go, go, through the snow!
item.guhs.sneeuwslee.lore2: Place it on snow or ice · W: go go · S: brake · A/D: steer · sneak + right-click: pick up
item.guhs.sledebelletje.lore: Ding-a-ling! Earned in the Nomguh Sled Sprint. Steele Mika trades them for wintry goodies.
item.guhs.baltoslee_sneeuwguh.lore: A snowman, but a guh. With a carrot snoot and a little scarf. Brrr-nyeg!
item.guhs.baltoslee_minislee.lore: A little sled with a red blankie. You can sit in it!
item.guhs.baltoslee_sledebellen.lore: Tap it: ding-a-ling-a-ling! Just like the Nomguh sled.
item.guhs.baltoslee_beker.lore: The golden cup of the fastest sled guh. With guh ears, of course.
item.guhs.baltoslee_hondenmand.lore: A warm basket with a cushion and a bone-shaped cheese nibble. For tired pawsies.
item.guhs.baltoslee_lantaarnpaal.lore: One of those lanterns that shows the sled route through the storm. Warm light, little snow cap on top.
subtitles.guhs.baltoslee.glijden: Sled runners glide over the snow
block.guhs.mewtwo_kloontank.lore: Professor Nibbleclone's big glass tank, full of bubbling pink nibble juice.
block.guhs.mewtwo_knabbelschaal.lore: A gigantic bowl for a DOUBLE helping. Fits exactly 32 cheese nibbles. Or more.
block.guhs.mewtwo_computer.lore: An old lab computer with a blinking little guh face on the screen. Bleep-nyeg!
block.guhs.mewtwo_reageerbuisjes.lore: Pink, purple and lilac nibble juice in little tubes. Don't drink it! (Unless you're double hungry.)
block.guhs.mewtwo_papieren.lore: Full of scribbles, formulas and drawings of cheese nibbles. Very important. Probably.
item.guhs.mewtwo_labnotitie.lore: Right-click to read. A scribble by Professor Nibbleclone.
item.guhs.mewtwo_tankonderdeel.lore: Fit it into the clone tank in the dome hall (right-click the tank).
item.guhs.mewtwo_trainerpetje.lore: With our very own logo: the nibble ball with guh ears. I choose you, nyeg!
item.guhs.mewtwo_trainerpakje.lore: A lilac trainer vest and a little backpack with a nibble ball on it.
item.guhs.mewtwo_staartje.lore: A soft purple tail with a little ball and a neck tube. Now you're a little bit Guhtwo too!
item.guhs.mew_ballonnetje.lore: A pink balloon that looks like Mewguh. It giggles when the wind blows. Hee hee!
item.guhs.mewtwo_tankonderdeel.1.lore: A curved piece of glass that fits the clone tank exactly. Careful, don't drop it!
item.guhs.mewtwo_tankonderdeel.2.lore: A shiny copper tube. Soon the nibble juice will flow through here.
item.guhs.mewtwo_tankonderdeel.3.lore: A little pump that goes blubblubblub. No bubbles, no happy tank!
item.guhs.mewtwo_tankonderdeel.4.lore: A bottle full of pink, fragrant nibble juice. Smells like cheese and strawberry. Nyeg!
item.guhs.herinnering.lore: A glowing little star full of sweet memories. Nyeg <3
item.guhs.herinnering.naar_het_hart: Bring it to the Snuggleheart in the Cloud Chapel (Super Compass, Tales tab).
item.guhs.herinnering.ook_zonder: The Snuggleheart can also bring them back without a little star.
block.guhs.guhwaii_palm_gezicht.lore: Every guh palm has a little face. Click it: it winks! Nyeg.
block.guhs.guhwaii_palm_blad.lore: Long waving leaves. Coconuts grow underneath!
item.guhs.kokosnoot.lore: Eat it (crack, slurp!), give it to your guh, or plant it in the sand: then a guh palm grows.
item.guhs.kokosmelk.lore: Cool and sweet, from a real Guhwai'i coconut. You feel a bit better right away. You get the bottle back.
item.guhs.guhwaii_ukelele.lore: Strum it (right-click): all the guhs around you start dancing. And a 626-guh plays along!
block.guhs.roze_hibiscus.lore: The prettiest flower of Guhwai'i. Lilo-guh wears one behind her ear.
block.guhs.guhwaii_plumeria.lore: White starry flowers with a sunny heart. They smell like vacation.
block.guhs.guhwaii_paradijsbloem.lore: An orange flower that looks like a little bird. Tweet? Nyeg!
block.guhs.guhwaii_orchidee.lore: A purple orchid on a graceful little arch.
block.guhs.schilly_eitjes.lore: They lie warm in the sand. Soon: crack, crack... little Shellies! No pawsies ever walk over them, promise.
block.guhs.vadsigheid_scanner.lore: From 626-guh's capsule. Put a guh on the plate and click: CHONKINESS LEVEL... INCALCULABLY WAHOOG!
block.guhs.vadsigheid_poster.lore: The famous picture: the meter goes all the way to INCALCULABLY WAHOOG. Hang it on the wall!
block.guhs.guhwaii_rommeltje.lore: Just a mess, nothing broken! Click it to tidy up.
painting.guhs.vadsigheidsniveau.title: Incalculably Wahoog
painting.guhs.vadsigheidsniveau.author: Experiment 626
item.guhs.schelpjesmunt.lore: Earned by surfing and hula on Guhwai'i. The Tiki Guh trades them for pretty Tiki goodies.
item.guhs.surfplankje_leen.lore: With this board you surf along with Lilo-guh. Watch out for the foam, nyeg!
item.guhs.surfplankje_leen.loan: Borrowed from Lilo-guh: after surfing it goes back to her hut.
block.guhs.tiki_fakkel.lore: A bamboo stick with a coconut-shell bowl and a cheerful little flame in it.
block.guhs.tiki_masker.lore: A carved guh tiki with big eyes and a wide grin. Hang it on the wall!
block.guhs.tiki_masker_roze.lore: Painted pink, with turquoise ears. The happiest mask on the beach.
block.guhs.tiki_beeld.lore: A guh tiki on a carved little body with a flower on its tummy. It keeps an eye on your house.
block.guhs.tiki_rietdak.lore: Thick straw roof, like on Lilo's surf hut. Crinkle!
block.guhs.tiki_bloemenslinger.lore: A garland of hibiscus and leaves, for on the wall. Instant party!
block.guhs.tiki_schelpjeslampion.lore: A little lamp of pink seashells that glows softly.
block.guhs.tiki_surfplankrek.lore: Three little surfboards in a bamboo rack: pink, turquoise and yellow.
block.guhs.tiki_bloemenmat.lore: A woven mat full of flowers. On stage you dance the hula on it!
block.guhs.tiki_kruk.lore: Bamboo legs, a woven seat. For your very own tiki bar.
block.guhs.tiki_radiootje.lore: Right-click: the hula songs of Guhwai'i, one after the other (and then off again).
block.guhs.tiki_radiootje.uit: The radio is quiet. Shh, nyeg.
item.guhs.pluisveertje.lore: As soft as a little cloud. From a Fluff Finch!
item.guhs.pluisveertje.lore2: The Cloud Shepherd of the Cloud Chapel is looking for one. Right-click: pfff!
block.guhs.vogels_voerhuisje.lore: Put seeds on it and the birdies come for a feast. Fluff Finches sometimes leave a feather behind!
item.guhs.guhxolotl_emmertje.tooltip: Right-click a block: splash, there it swims again! (Sneak: without water)
item.guhs.landdiertjes_guhsteentje.lore: Polished smooth and shiny by a Shuckly. Four of them make a guh pebble path.
item.guhs.landdiertjes_bessensapje.lore: Sweet berries, made into juice veeery patiently inside a Shuckly's shell. Slurp! Nyeg.
item.guhs.pluisegeltje_item.tooltip: A picked-up fluffhog (name and all). Right-click a block: it snuffles off again.
item.guhs.guh_konijntje_item.tooltip: A picked-up guh bunny (name and all). Right-click a block: hop, off it goes!
item.guhs.pluiseekhoorntje_item.tooltip: Right-click a block: the squirrel jumps off. Right-click in the air: onto your shoulder!
item.guhs.shuckle_item.tooltip: A picked-up Shuckly (name and all). Sitting snug in its shell. Right-click a block: off it goes, veeery slowly.
guhs.configuration.title: Guhs Settings
guhs.configuration.language.tooltip: The language you read the Guhs texts in. AUTO follows the Minecraft language (Dutch for nl_nl, English for anything else); NL is always Dutch, EN always English. Only for you, also on servers. You can also switch with the language button in your Guhdex.
emote.guhs.aaien.description: Squishes flat with happiness for a moment, eyes shut, and pushes its little head against your hand.
block.guhs.wilde_guhweerder.lore: Put it in your house or base: no more wild guhs pop up in the area around it. Right-click: choose how big the area is and show it as a blue dome.
block.guhs.wilde_guhweerder.lore.lief: Very sweet, nyeg! Wild guhs see the sign and know: a chonky lives here already. So they just go cuddle somewhere else.
block.guhs.guh_oven.lore: No coal or charcoal needed: it bakes on guh power! Put it next to a running Guh Wheel, or hook it up with Guh Wire. It doesn't care for plain redstone.
block.guhs.guh_oven.lore.lief: The little guh runs in the wheel, and the oven bakes the nibbles. Chonky teamwork, nyeg!
guhs.configuration.languageChosen.toolti: Off = the question 'Which language for Guhs?' comes once more when you join a world or server.
entity.guhs.quest_guh.al_gehad: Guh! You already got my buddy the Bank Guh. Everybody gets one from me, so take good care of it!
block.guhs.bleekhout_gezicht: Sleepy Guh Face in the Bark
